coverage.summary: Applies to any landlord or agent requiring an application or similar fee to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes.

rules.effective_date_note: The retrieved text does not state an effective date.
rules.key_value: Application fee max $50; penalty up to $500 first offense, up to $750 second offense, up to $1,000 each subsequent offense
rules.quoted_span:
A landlord, or
agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply
to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which
exceeds $50.
rules.requirement: A landlord or agent may not require an application or similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes that exceeds $50. Violations carry civil penalties enforced by summary proceedings under the Penalty Enforcement Law of 1999 in the Superior Court, Special Civil Part.
